title: Implement Automatic Retry Mechanism for Failed Requests
description: This feature matters because it improves the overall user experience by automatically retrying failed requests, reducing the need for manual retries and enhancing the framework's reliability. It does this by integrating a retry mechanism that can be configured to retry failed requests a specified number of times with a backoff delay. This enhances the framework's resilience and performance.
testCases: Test case 1: Successful retry after a single failure
Test case 2: Failure after maximum retries exceeded
acceptance: The feature is considered complete when requests that fail due to temporary errors are automatically retried up to a specified number of times with a configurable backoff delay, and the request is successful or fails after the maximum retries have been exceeded.
reason: Implementing an automatic retry mechanism is a high-impact feature that directly addresses real-world problems of temporary failures, improving the framework's reliability and user experience, which aligns with the current focus on feature development and stability.
